openwrt_wiki.einleitung: Dual Band wireless 5GHz and 2.4GHz. Based on Atheros chipset. Four 100MB LAN ethernet. One 100MB WAN.
openwrt_wiki.warnung: The C60v3 is leaking LAN traffic through WAN port during boot, due to lack of port isolation.
openwrt_wiki.installation_v1: NOTE: At least for Archer C60 v1, using the WebUI to install OpenWRT works fine as of March 2022. The v1 devices haven't had a firmware update since 2016, so this is unlikely to stop working in the future.
openwrt_wiki.oem_easy_installation: For Archer C60 v1.x, v2.0, v2.1, v3.0 installing OpenWrt is confirmed to work by simply uploading the OpenWrt firmware in the stock OEM's firmware-upgrade page. ... refuse to install firmware uploaded with a long filename ... rename the file to something shorter like firmware.bin
openwrt_wiki.tftp: Latest OEM firmware seems to prevent flashing via TFTP.
openwrt_wiki.uart_install: Interrupt boot during Autoboot delay. You only have 1 second to type 'tpl<enter>' to get Ath> prompt. TFTP server 192.168.0.10 (Abschnitt für C60v2)
openwrt_wiki.flash_chip_methode: direkt auf Flash-Chip (W25Q64), getestet mit v3 und Dump von v2
openwrt_wiki.flash_layout_mtd: u-boot 0x30000, firmware 0x7a0000, kernel 0x180000, rootfs 0x620000, rootfs_data 0x360000, tplink 0x20000, art 0x10000 (Version nicht genannt, Layout passt nicht zum v1-DTS)
openwrt_wiki.opening_the_case: Remove Phillips screws on bottom of case. Gently pry top from base ... putty knife ... plastic catches ... near the ethernet ports at the back release the easiest
openwrt_wiki.serial: There is an unpopulated 4 pin serial header (J1) present on the left side of the PCB. The pin close to the rear of the unit (TX) is marked with a sideways triangle. Pins: TX, RX, Gnd, Vcc (3.3V). UART operates at 3.3V. Factory units do not have this header installed.
openwrt_wiki.serial_parameter: for TP-Link Archer C60 v2: 115200 (or 118000 for CH341A serial adapter), 8N1
openwrt_wiki.oem_bootlog: Archer C60(CA)_V2_161206: U-Boot 1.1.4 (Nov 29 2016), ap151 - Dragonfly 1.0, DRAM 64 MB, Flash Manuf Id 0xc8 (GigaDevice) 8MB; Kernel 3.3.8, 'MIPS: machine is TP-LINK ARCHER_C60V1 reference board', QCA9888/hw.2 boarddata
